description: Zeck quota guard and operational alert thresholds (WORK-047 / D-06; the free-tier operating doctrine: meter usage, alert BEFORE exhaustion, make limits visible, no uncontrolled paid overage). Snapshots are collected from the AUTHORITATIVE stores only (the compute-plane quota tables, the queue-transport envelope counts, the execution authority's terminal outcomes, the database size) — never from provider dashboards or control planes. Provider-side quota meters (Neon/Cloudflare consoles) are out of scope without credentials and are documented NOT RUN, never claimed.

compute-claims.description: Live worker claims per compute environment vs the environment quota (the D-05 hard cap; fail-closed at the limit — uncontrolled overage is unrepresentable).

queue-backlog.description: Pending dispatch envelopes vs the backlog bound (bounded re-delivery pressure).

database-size.description: pg_database_size of the authoritative store vs the declared size limit (provider plan ceiling declared by the operator; default 5 GiB).
